operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2025}} to {{passengers@FY2025}}, with the summer programme carrying a large number of routes including new leisure destinations.
Fuel made up {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2025}} of costs, broadly unchanged on the prior year, so the cost base remains exposed to jet fuel prices.
The group acquired previously leased Boeing 737-800 aircraft, which the report links to accounting gains and recurring cost savings, and it exercised its option for additional 737 MAX 8 aircraft.
New collective bargaining agreements with pilots, cabin crew and technicians were concluded during the year, fixing labour terms across the group.
